text: My day follows a simple but effective routine that helps me stay productive and healthy. I wake up at six thirty every morning, drink a glass of water, and do ten minutes of stretching before breakfast. By eight, I’m at my desk starting work, usually focusing on my most demanding tasks first when my mind is freshest. I take a short lunch break at noon and go for a brisk twenty-minute walk. After finishing work around five, I hit the gym for an hour, alternating between cardio and strength training. Evenings are for cooking dinner, reading, or watching a show with my family. I’m in bed by ten thirty. Consistency is key—it keeps my energy stable and my mood positive all week long.
